events.title: StateOS 0.2: Campaign Strategy Update
events.summary: StateOS 0.2: Campaign Strategy UpdateThis update brings the new election campaign system into the main game, alongside improvements to government, legislation, politician development, election night, and the World Archive.The biggest change is how you fight an election. Campaigns now have their own full-screen workspace, with the map at the center, your actions beside it, and clearer feedback about the voters you are winning and losing.
